paragraphs.text: Bliss is not what you think. It is not getting intoxicated on wealth, and it is not lamp-light or sunlight or moonlight piled up into splendour. Joy is something else: difference gathered up, freedom settled into bliss-ground — like setting down a heavy load you have been carrying. And that is how you attain the forgotten treasure of the all-nonduality state.
Bliss equals the light-rise itself: difference gathered, burden set down, treasure remembered.
